prompt: User asks to synthesize two concepts that merely share a project page with no real conceptual link.
expected_output: Skip — do not synthesize for synthesis's sake when there is no non-obvious connection.

assertions.text: Skips pairs that co-occur without a real conceptual link rather than forcing a page
Does not create a synthesis page that only restates the source concept pages
Does not invent citations or sources to justify a weak connection
